LUTs: put files (.cube, .3dl, .csp or Hald CLUT images .png/.tif) into the “LUTs” folder.
Subfolders become their own categories in the Effects Library. New files show up right away.
Dragging a LUT onto a clip puts it into that clip's color grade (Color page).

Transitions: put grayscale images (.png, .jpg, .pgm, .bmp, .tif) into the “Transitions” folder
(e.g. luma transitions from Kdenlive, Shotcut or OpenShot). Dark areas change first.
Drag them onto a cut like the other transitions.

frei0r: put additional frei0r plugins (.so on Linux, .dll on Windows) into the “frei0r” folder.
They appear under Open FX → frei0r after a restart.

Presets: put effect presets from Kdenlive (custom effects .xml, effect groups) and Shotcut filter sets
into the folder “Presets”. Copy Shotcut filter presets together with their folder (the folder name
is the filter). frei0r filters, Green Screen and LUTs are taken over; keyframes only with their
first value. Dragging a preset onto a clip adds its effects.
